page.layout: One column of running text, with a two-line Horace quotation set in italics inside it. No marginal notes. The running head is at the top.

main_text.p: testimonium prębens: sic minus docti, & inertis animæ oculi nihil in historijs intrinsecus cernere possunt: nec ad considerandam mentis historicę sublimitatem conscendunt, maxime vbi ipsa narratio conscientiam arguit, & medelam suggerit. Hæc autem summam cum voluptate vtilitatem auditoribus prębebunt, eoqs magis, quemadmodum spero, nostrum hunc laborem commendabunt, quo & antiquiora, & salubriora omnia tota hac narratio continebit. Ergo (liceat enim mihi propter antiquitatem illud Virgilianum hoc loco vsurpare) volumus, Pandere res alta terra, & caligine tectas: & propter vtilitatem illud Horat. huic scriptioni pręfigere
Porrò autem hanc meam operam atque historiā, Fuillati, vir Generose, tibi dedicare iamprídem apud me constitueram, multis

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment, so the first paragraph is marked as continued. The Horace lines are printed in square brackets and italics inside the text block; they are kept as quotation paragraphs. The "u" in some words is rendered as "v" where the printer used v. Two small marks in the left margin near the bottom are show-through or stains and are not transcribed. No page number is printed.
